component: Panorama Unicode tests and assertion diagnostics

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This normalization landing re-enables decomposed path/child lookup, Bcc and migrated-recipient checks that call Assert.equal without an expected-behavior message. The changed InternalInsertFolder MOZ_ASSERT also has no message. Nearby insertion and sender/subject helper assertions do supply messages, so the finding is limited to the affected calls. A test name or nearby Unicode comment does not supply the missing argument. This is a diagnostic source finding, not an observed test failure; missing should alone is not the issue. The exact backout disables these checks and the reland restores them.
title: Re-enabled Panorama Unicode checks still need assertion messages
